patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: Mahabharat Range in Nepal, Kashmir valley in Himachal range, Patkai Bum in Arunachal, Shillong on Khasi hills, K2 in Karakoram
Highest peak in India: APPSC key = Kanchenjunga, but other PSC keys give K2 - teach both framings
Regional division by rivers (Sutlej-Kali = Kumaon) and peak-height matching (Everest 8848, Kanchenjunga 8598, Nanga Parbat 8126, Nanda Devi 7817) recur
Pass-state matching and W-E pass/peak sequences dominate other PSCs; app covers these well
App leans on multi-statement structure items (origin, slopes, Molasse) more than PYQs; PYQs favour location/sequence recall
